info.title: Rever UI-to-Prompt API
info.summary: Turn a website URL into a prompt for recreating its UI.
info.description: Takes a full-page screenshot of a public URL and returns a detailed design brief (layout, components, colors, typography, spacing) that a code-generation model can use to rebuild the UI in React + Tailwind. Humans authenticate with a Supabase user token and spend credits. Agents can pay 1 USDC on Base per call: call once to get a 402 with payment details, pay, then retry with the transaction hash in the X-Payment header. Full guide: https://www.aypiai.online/llms-full.txt

post.summary: Generate a UI-recreation prompt from a URL
post.description: Use when a user wants to clone, copy or recreate the design of an existing website. Returns a text prompt (not code); pass it to a code model to generate the UI. Takes 10-30 seconds.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the page to recreate.

prompt.description: Design brief to give to a code-generation model.

402.description: Payment required. Pay the amount in accepts[0] (USDC on Base) to payTo, then retry with header X-Payment set to the transaction hash.

502.description: Screenshot or model failed; agent payments are released and can be retried.

x402Payment.name: X-Payment
x402Payment.description: Base transaction hash of a 1 USDC transfer to the payTo address. Single use.

userToken.description: Supabase user JWT from the web app.
